reviews.t: Nice sponge. I wanted something other than those plastic ...
reviews.x: Nice sponge. I wanted something other than those plastic showers scrunchies and this totally does the trick. They are a little bigger than I expected, but that is not a bad thing. I will buy these again.

reviews.t: but these are fantastic. It coming in a two pack my daughter ...
reviews.x: I am not a fan of the hard loufa sponges, but these are fantastic. It coming in a two pack my daughter and I can have one of our own. They are nice and perfect for a light exfoliating.

reviews.t: and doesn't come off easily. This sponge does the job perfectly
reviews.x: I use natural oil products on my skin daily. I need to put on a fresh coat of oil on daily. With other sponges it just rubs it around on my skin, and the dead skin, and doesn't come off easily.  This sponge does the job perfectly. It takes off the oil, and easily rubs against my skin to remove any dead cells as well.

Wonderful. Wonderful. Wonderful.  The quality is so much better than other foam sponges I've purchased and the price is fantastic!  We only lather them up once and it lasts throughout the shower/bath.  They are much thicker (denser) than those we've used before and we will return to purchase more of these.  I'm glad amazon makes it easy for us to reorder their products.

reviews.t: You will love them - give them a try
reviews.x: These are quality sponges.  I have been searching for some that don't just fall apart and finally found them.  These cost just a little more than the ones at my local store, but I will not have to replace them every week.  You will love them - give them a try.

I bought these because I got tired of the meshy plasticky round ball ones that unravel after a brief time. I love mine but my wife didn't like hers and went back to the other style. They are a little ruff on the skin but I feel very clean after my shower. Great at exfoliating if you ask me but again my wife thought they were a little too ruff. I guess it's a personal taste thing, you may or may not like these but for the price of these it won't be a big deal if they don't work out for you. Also

I've tried every kind of "exfoliating" sponge out there to be disappointed the majority of the time.  These are actually very scrubby, which is what every other sponge/loofa/puff seems to lack.  This is literally the first time I've been happy with the amount of exfoliation a sponge provided. However, after a week of use, there's a split already forming... which bums me out.  I'll still use it until it completely falls apart, but I would think it should have lasted longer than a week.

These are the perfect balance between softness - size - and abrasion.  These have some meat to them so they hold lots of soap.  They are just the right amount of abrasive - just enough to do a gentle exfoliation.  Will buy them again.

reviews.t: This is used daily for bathing an infant (primarily just ...
reviews.x: This is used daily for bathing an infant (primarily just to squeeze water onto him), and bits began falling off less than two months after purchase. Still, for the price and its purpose, it will do.
Terrific sponges!  Feels like a spa treatment - very exfoliating.  Don't know how long they last but I really like taking a shower with them.

reviews.t: These are the best that I have found
reviews.x: These are the best that I have found. Mos r products don't even last a week before they fall apart.
These work great!  Last about a month.  Definitely purchasing again!!!
Excellent sponges and hold up very well for quite some time.

reviews.t: They are ok. But there has to be something better. ..
reviews.x: These are fine, but not great. There is not enough surface area to get a good scrub and the rope attached takes away from your ability to lather and scrub. Like most loofahs and sponges, you should only use for about two weeks before replacing, and this is about the life span of these sponges as they are starting to fall apart. I think there has to be a better alternative out there though.

reviews.t: These are excellent sponges. It definitely helps you to get clean ...
reviews.x: These are excellent sponges. It definitely helps you to get clean in comparison to using body wash and your hands. I enjoy that exfoliating feel when I scrub with these sponges. The price is superb for the product being received. I would definitely purchase these again and recommend it to anyone who wants a cleaner showering experience!

It's okay- not crazy about the size, it doesn't fit naturally in the hand, I have it for less than a week and it's starting to fall apart and I found the texture to be a bit rough (unless that's what you're looking for but does soften a bit with time). I wouldn't get again but okay if you need something for now.

I have really enjoyed mine, but my husband's tore in the middle the first time he used it. Mine has only had minor pieces fall off so far. His continues to shred and it just hasn't been a good experience for him. Also, both look identical so I'm wondering how these sponges can be organic? Are they?

This sponge is huge and very absorbent. It takes forever to completely rinse out. BUT I will say it seems to scrape my dead skin off! It's almost like a white hot tingling sensation when you use it (not in a bad way lol) My skin is so soft. I use it on my body, haven't tried it on my face.

These barely last a month without falling apart. They are rather stiff and never softened up for me. After 3 months they were in little pieces and clogging up my bath drain. I really don't recommend this product at all. Spend a little bit more for a natural sponge. That lasted me forever.

I like the general feel of this bath sponge. I have fairly sensitive skin so its quite gentle. Unlike other similar products, it doesn't fall apart after 2-3 uses which is what you want in a bath sponge. I use its with a body wash that has exfoliating beads and it works great with that!

I enjoyed using this scrubby, not only because the look of it is different but also because the texture of the sponge is rough just enough to exfoliate your skin. The scrubby can last a few months when you soak it in a little bleach/water mix every other week or so. Id buy it again.

If you like bath sponges then this would probably be great for you.  If you are a loofah person then stay away. It's very soft and it just doesn't scrub the way a loofah does.  I didn't feel like I was getting myself as clean. It didn't lather as good as I thought it would either.

reviews.t: These are the best sponges I have ever used
reviews.x: These are the best sponges I have ever used, and I have tried many different kinds. They are long lasting and do not fall apart quickly like others do. I wish they were a bit larger because the cord can get in the way a bit, but once I adjusted to that, it has been great.

As a man, I prefer a sponge with a rougher texture. One that makes me feel like it's scrubbing my face and body. This sponge is very soft and more befitting of what I think a woman might prefer. It's also very thick and dense, which just doesn't work for me.

Love these.  Replaced the old plastic mesh shower scrub with these!  My skins feels smoother.  The sponge has a slightly different texture on either side providing for variations in how it feels against your skin.  Energizing and invigorating.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the sponges for effective exfoliation and getting clean.
Many reviewers say they would buy again or recommend them, citing good value and quality.
Several reviewers note the sponges are durable and hold up better than other sponges that fall apart.
A few reviewers find the sponges too rough or scrubby on the skin.
Some reviewers report the sponges wear out or shed bits within a short time.
